test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid email and strong password
preconditions: User exists in registered-user DB with Username=email user@example.com and Password=Str0ng!Pass
test_cases.expected_result: Flash message 'Signed in successfully.' appears and user is redirected to Accounts Overview page showing welcome message and account table

test_cases.test_case: Failed login with incorrect password clears password and shows error
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.' is shown; password field is cleared and username remains populated for retry

test_cases.test_case: Login with invalid email format is rejected client-side
test_cases.expected_result: Client-side validation prevents submission and shows email format error (e.g., 'Enter a valid email address')

test_cases.test_case: Login with weak password (fails complexity) is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is rejected; validation message indicates password requires uppercase, lowercase, number, special character, and minimum length

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to Register from sign-in page
test_cases.expected_result: Registration page opens with full sign-up form including First Name, Last Name, Address fields, State dropdown, SSN, Username(email), Password and Confirm Password

test_cases.test_case: Successful registration with valid data redirects to login with success message
preconditions: No existing account with username newuser@example.com
steps: 1. Fill all required fields with valid values (First/Last Name, Address, City, State selected, ZIP 12345, Phone (123) 456-7890, SSN 123-45-6789, Username newuser@example.com, Password Strong1!, Confirm Password Strong1!)
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Account created successfully — please sign in' is displayed and user is redirected to sign-in page

test_cases.test_case: Registration fails when required fields are missing
steps: 1. Leave First Name blank and fill other fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation highlights First Name as required and prevents registration; no redirect occurs

test_cases.test_case: Registration rejects invalid email username format
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error next to Username: 'Enter a valid email address' and registration blocked

test_cases.test_case: Registration phone number auto-formatting and validation
steps: 1. Enter Phone Number digits 1234567890 without formatting
2. Move focus away (blur) or submit form
test_cases.expected_result: Phone number auto-formats to (123) 456-7890; if format accepted, no error shown

test_cases.test_case: Registration SSN auto-formatting and validation
test_cases.expected_result: SSN auto-formats to 123-45-6789 and is accepted; no error shown if pattern correct

test_cases.test_case: Registration ZIP 5+4 format accepted
test_cases.expected_result: ZIP accepted; account created and redirected with success message

test_cases.test_case: Registration password and confirm password mismatch rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Passwords do not match' is shown and registration prevented

test_cases.test_case: Accounts Overview displays masked account numbers and total footer
preconditions: User signed in with multiple accounts: account A (balance 100), account B (balance 200)
steps: 1. Log in and view Accounts Overview
test_cases.expected_result: Each account number is masked (e.g., ****5001), table ordered by open date (earliest first), an 'Active' badge shown, and footer displays total balance 300

test_cases.test_case: Account rows ordered by open date earliest first
steps: 1. Sign in and navigate to Accounts Overview
test_cases.expected_result: Rows are sorted with 2020-01-01 first, then 2021-01-01, then 2022-01-01

test_cases.test_case: Open New Checking account with minimum deposit succeeds
preconditions: User signed in and has funding account with balance >= 25
steps: 4. Select Funding Source account with sufficient balance
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Account opened successfully!' appears and user redirected to Accounts Overview with new checking account listed

test_cases.test_case: Open New Savings account with insufficient deposit rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation shows 'Minimum initial deposit for Savings is $100' and account is not created

test_cases.test_case: Open New Account when funding source lacks sufficient balance shows error
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Insufficient funds in funding account' shown inline; account not opened

test_cases.test_case: Transfer between own accounts completes successfully
preconditions: User signed in with Checking $500 and Savings $1000
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Transfer completed successfully.' appears with a transaction ID; balances update (Savings 800, Checking 700)

test_cases.test_case: Transfer fails when source account has insufficient funds
preconditions: User signed in with Source account balance = 50
steps: 3. Choose Source with 50, Destination other account
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Insufficient funds' is displayed and transfer not executed

test_cases.test_case: External transfer requires matching account numbers and rejects mismatch
steps: 5. Enter valid amount and funding source
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Account numbers do not match.' displayed and transfer blocked

test_cases.test_case: Transfer amount boundary: transfer full available balance succeeds (if allowed)
preconditions: User signed in with Source balance = 1000
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer succeeds with 'Transfer completed successfully.' and source balance becomes 0 (or as permitted) and transaction ID shown

test_cases.test_case: Bill payment submission succeeds with valid payee and funds
steps: 2. Enter Payee Name and full address fields
3. Enter Payee Account Number and Confirm Account Number matching
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Payment submitted successfully.' with reference code appears; source account balance reduced accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Bill payment fails when payee account numbers do not match
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Account numbers do not match' shown; payment not submitted

test_cases.test_case: Bill payment fails when insufficient funds in source account
preconditions: User signed in with source account balance = 50
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Insufficient funds' displayed; payment not executed

test_cases.test_case: Loan request approved when credit engine approves and down payment meets minimum
preconditions: Loan type Personal with allowed range, down payment >= 10% and >= 10% of loan amount as required, collateral adequate if required
steps: 5. Select Collateral Account with required value
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Loan approved and created successfully!' appears with account details

test_cases.test_case: Loan request rejected when down payment below minimum 10%
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Minimum down payment is 10%' or denial shown; loan not created

test_cases.test_case: Loan denied due to inadequate collateral value
preconditions: Credit engine seeded for possible denial
Selected collateral account value less than 20% required
steps: 3. Select Collateral Account with value < 20% of loan
test_cases.expected_result: Denial message 'Inadequate collateral value' shown (or loan denied) and no account created

test_cases.test_case: Update Contact Info with valid edits succeeds and data refreshes
preconditions: User signed in with profile data prefilled
steps: 2. Change Street Address and Phone Number to valid values
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Profile updated successfully.' displayed; page refreshes showing updated address and phone

test_cases.test_case: Update Contact Info rejects invalid ZIP or phone format
test_cases.expected_result: Inline errors shown for ZIP and Phone fields; form not submitted

test_cases.test_case: Request Card submission with complete address and valid account creates ticket
preconditions: User signed in and selected account in good standing
steps: 2. In Request Card form select 'Debit', choose Account to Link, fill Shipping Address completely
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Card request submitted successfully.' with a tracking ID displayed; ticket created

test_cases.test_case: Request Card rejected when shipping address incomplete
steps: 1. In Request Card form leave Street Address blank
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error highlighting shipping address required; no ticket created

test_cases.test_case: Update card controls with valid spending limit and travel notice succeeds
preconditions: User signed in and has existing card selected
steps: 1. In Card Controls form select existing card
2. Enter New Spending Limit within policy, set Travel Notice dates valid (start < end), choose status Active
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Card controls updated successfully.' displayed and controls saved

test_cases.test_case: Card controls reject spending limit above policy
steps: 2. Enter New Spending Limit = value above allowed maximum
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error 'Spending limit exceeds policy' shown; update not saved

test_cases.test_case: Card controls reject invalid date range for travel notice
steps: 1. Enter Travel Notice Start Date = 2025-12-31 and End Date = 2025-01-01 (end before start)
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'End date must be after start date' displayed; update not applied

test_cases.test_case: View Investments portfolio snapshot displays holdings and market values
preconditions: User signed in and has holdings
test_cases.expected_result: Read-only panel lists funds, current market values and unrealised gains/losses for each holding

test_cases.test_case: Execute Buy trade with valid symbol and sufficient funds succeeds
preconditions: User signed in with sufficient buying power
steps: 1. In Trade Funds form select Action=Buy
4. Choose Funding Account with sufficient funds
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Trade executed successfully.' with order ID shown; holdings updated and buying power reduced

test_cases.test_case: Execute trade fails with nonexistent fund symbol
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Fund symbol not found' displayed and trade not executed

test_cases.test_case: Sell trade fails when quantity exceeds holdings
preconditions: User signed in and holds 5 shares of fund ABC
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Quantity exceeds available shares' displayed; trade not executed

test_cases.test_case: Create recurring investment plan with future start date
preconditions: Funding account has adequate balance for initial contribution
steps: 1. Go to Recurring Investment Plan form
3. Enter Contribution Amount meeting minimum, Frequency=Monthly, Start Date = next month date, Funding Account selected
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Plan created successfully.' displayed and schedule saved

test_cases.test_case: Recurring plan creation rejected when start date is in the past
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Start date must be in the future' shown; plan not created

test_cases.test_case: Generate monthly account statement for selected account
preconditions: Account has transactions in selected month
steps: 2. In Generate Statement form select Statement Period = June 2026 and choose Account
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Statement generated successfully.' displayed and statement with relevant transactions shown or downloadable

test_cases.test_case: Generate statement with invalid custom date range where start > end is rejected
steps: 1. Choose custom date range with Start Date later than End Date
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Start date must be before end date' and generation blocked

test_cases.test_case: Update e-statement preference with valid email
steps: 1. On e-statement preference form check 'paperless statements' box
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'e-Statement preference updated.' displayed; preference saved

test_cases.test_case: E-statement preference rejects invalid email format
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Enter a valid email address' displayed and preference not saved

test_cases.test_case: Change password with correct current password and strong new password succeeds
preconditions: User signed in with current password Curr3nt!Pass
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Password changed successfully.' displayed and credentials updated

test_cases.test_case: Change password fails when current password incorrect
steps: 2. Enter New Password and Confirm New Password valid and matching
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Current password is incorrect' shown; password not changed

test_cases.test_case: Change password rejects weak new password not meeting complexity
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error describing password policy requirements; change not applied

test_cases.test_case: Send secure message with attachment and receive ticket ID
steps: 1. Go to Support Center -> Secure Message
2. Enter Subject, select Category=Account, fill Message Body
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Message sent successfully.' appears with a ticket ID; attachment accepted

test_cases.test_case: Secure message rejects unsupported attachment type
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Attachment type not allowed' and message not sent

test_cases.test_case: Schedule callback rejects preferred date earlier than next business day
steps: 2. Choose Preferred Date = today (not next business day)
3. Select Preferred Time Window and click 'Request Callback'
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Preferred date must be at least the next business day' shown; callback not scheduled
